1. (Currently amended) A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; __radially reinforcing the device against brain tissue to maintain the working channel;__ and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

2. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument.

3. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening __into brain parenchyma__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device __through brain parenchyma__ between tissue layers within the brain.

6. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain.

7. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __to maintain structural integrity of the working channel__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument __and the tissue is brain tissue__.

9. (Previously presented) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device __through brain parenchyma__ between tissue layers.

11. (Previously presented) The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue.

12. (Previously presented) The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.

13. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue; __maintaining the stent in position to provide structural support to the working channel;__ and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue.

14. (Previously presented) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument.

15. (Previously presented) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

16. (Previously presented) The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers.

17. (Previously presented) The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
